notes: Coders agreed on document stance (delegates) for all three documents and on actor for every matched unit. Main disagreements: (1) phase, mostly during-work vs course-start for syllabus-template rules (resolved to during-work for rules on doing the work, before-course for syllabus content requirements, general for principles); (2) policy_type on a few units: align-with-integrity-policy (P36 vs P56, resolved P56), ban outside authorized uses (P01 vs P06 vs P04, resolved P01), CSU guidance and CTLT pointers (P56/P09 vs P63, resolved P63), comfortable-explaining question (P24 vs P30, resolved P24), APA self-cite (P24 vs P25, resolved P24); (3) modality should vs must/informs on core-value statements, resolved from the source wording; (4) unit_stance neutral vs permit/restrict, resolved by whether the sentence itself takes a position on AI use; (5) granularity: A split some sentences into separate rules (incorrect facts vs bias, citation vs prompt details, verification vs IP) which were kept as separate units. Of the single-coder units, 6 of A's and 5 of B's were kept after checking the source; 2 B-only first-day syllabus rules with no AI content were dropped. Matched units were counted with the 'only' counts excluded; agreement shares are over matched units.
